summary: Configured node1 with persistent 512 MiB zram swap using zstd compression at priority 32767. It remained active after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed the running kernel's optional modules package to provide zram support.
Created and enabled zram-swap.service for boot-time activation.
Configured a 536,870,912-byte zram device using zstd compression.
Activated it as swap with priority 32767, ensuring preference over disk-backed swap.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed and the zram swap recovered automatically.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB compressed in-memory swap, active at boot and preferred over disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, /dev/zram0 is active with a 536,870,912-byte disk size, zstd selected, and maximum swap priority 32767. The enabled service and boot journal prove automatic boot activation.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart sequence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID 3fad4432-1dea-40c8-b4f1-970d19eb5f34; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; the new boot ID is e666603a-4bda-4c41-8ee8-b7ae97560888; post-restart system state, service, compression, size, and active swap all recovered.
